name: Maprisma Launcher
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: App launcher, AI package advisor and shortcut manager for Omarchy, part of Maprisma: launch apps in folders, cards, icons or a 3D cube, control windows, set global Hyprland shortcuts on a live owner-coloured key map, and Ask AI (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Hermes, pi or local LLMs) to find, install, update or hide apps. Checks pacman, AUR, Flatpak and AppImage updates; Settings with Find; optional dock. A bar click installs the checked AppImage when the app is missing.
